title: 第15章 这就引气入体了第16章 爱吃是福
slug: 开局逼我献祭我有天道赐福
content_zh:
典籍司从外面看像是一座塔楼，里面却大得惊人，一眼望不到头。
温郗看了眼一楼大厅的指示牌，上面标着二楼是常识入门类的书籍，她转身走上旋转楼梯来到二楼，里面的景象映入眼帘——
顶到天花板的书架上塞满了竹简、书和发光的玉牌。许多弟子安静地坐在蒲团上看书，没人说话，只有偶尔翻页的沙沙声。
温郗找了个位置，开始看书了解启明洲的常识。
时间不知不觉流逝，等到温郗再抬起头的时候，是典籍司的值班人员说要闭馆了。
温郗：？
‘怎么一眨眼就要闭馆了？’
小明：‘我嘞个小希啊，你的一眨眼是四个小时吗？’
温郗：‘天啊，办正事的时候时间果然过的很快。’
——————
从典籍司里出来的时候，夜已经很深了。
温郗拿起一本《引气入体教程》走下楼梯，打算晚上回去继续挑灯夜读。
她在大厅里张望了一圈，思索借书的流程是什么。
温郗眨眨眼，从空间戒指里拿出了新生手册，按照上面的指示走到了大厅的左侧，那里有几个正按照一定频率闪烁着微光的阵盘。
按照流程图，温郗先是把手里的书放在阵盘上，又把自己的身份牌放在了指定位置。
下一秒，她面前便出现一片光幕，光幕上有着灵力聚集而成的一句话——
【欢迎借阅典籍司书籍，请在借阅期间妥善保管，按时归还，书籍损坏、丢失、延期归还均会有所处罚。】
【请选择您的借阅时长。】
温郗：……
启明洲真的好先进。

这些阵法到底是哪个天才发明的。
弄完所有手续后，温郗把书收进空间手镯，打算去食堂拿俩馒头，半夜饿的时候啃两口垫垫肚子。
可惜，温郗来到食堂的时候已经关门了。
她摸了摸自己的肚子，有些遗憾地返回宿舍——
嗯，明天一定要记得提前拿两个馒头存宿舍里。
回到宿舍的时候，温郗在房间门口看见了一个食盒。
她缓缓蹲下，掀开食盒，最上面那层是一叠鱼香肉丝和几叠咸菜，下面一层是碗灵米熬制的米粥。
温郗移开筷子，看见了一张字条——
“小郗，很抱歉又擅自做了可能会让你困扰的事情，但食堂闭馆后就拿不到饭了，我看你短时间内并没有从典籍司出来的打算，便拿了些吃食托鹿辞霜送到了你的宿舍。”
“不必担心，我在上面封了一层灵力，别人打不开的。”
落款是萧杙。
从字里行间温郗都能想象到萧杙留下这字条的时候，肯定又是面带笑容、语气温和。
温郗的手搭在食盒边缘，指尖还能感受到饭菜飘出的热气。
她略微垂眸，神色尽数藏在月光下的阴影中，连带着眉心的红痣也失了几分颜色。
温郗捻着手里的字条，有些无措。
虽说是生成的身份，不存在顶替这种事情，但温郗总觉得无论是萧杙还是天启的国主国后都是因为剧情设定而关心她。
而她本就没怎么跟陌生人相处过，所以，总是很别扭啊……
温郗无奈叹了口气。
要赶紧成为亲传弟子，最好是人少的一个峰，那样就不用跟陌生人相处了。
她还是习惯跟花花草草待在一起。

——————
走进房间，温郗收拾了一下空间戒指，准备好了第二天上课要穿的弟子制服。
她拿起湿毛巾擦了把脸，把精神调起来后，翻开《引气入体教程》细细看了下去，每一句话都力求完全理解。
看完第一遍，温郗盘腿坐在了打坐台上，将书摊开放于自己身前。
content_en:
The Department of Classics looks like a tower from the outside, but it is so huge inside that you can't even see the end of it.
Wen Xi glanced at the sign in the lobby on the first floor. It said that the second floor was for introductory books on common sense. She turned around and walked up the spiral staircase to the second floor. The scene inside came into view——
The ceiling-to-ceiling bookshelves are crammed with bamboo slips, books and glowing jade plaques. Many disciples sat quietly on futons and read books. No one spoke, only the occasional rustle of turning pages.
Wen Xi found a seat and started reading to learn about Qimingzhou's common sense.
Time passed unconsciously, and when Wen Xi raised his head again, it was the person on duty at the Classics Department who said the library was closing.
Wen Xi:?
‘Why is it that the museum is going to be closed in the blink of an eye? ’
Xiao Ming: ‘My dear Xiao Xi, does your blink of an eye last four hours? ’
Wen Xi: ‘Oh my God, time really flies when we’re doing business. ’
——————
When I came out of the Classics Department, the night was already very late.
Wen Xi picked up a copy of "A Tutorial on Introducing Qi into the Body" and walked down the stairs, planning to go back and continue reading at night.
She looked around the hall, wondering what the procedure was for borrowing books.
Wen Xi blinked, took out the freshman manual from the space ring, and followed the instructions above to walk to the left side of the hall, where there were several array disks that were flashing at a certain frequency.
According to the flow chart, Wen Xi first placed the book in his hand on the array plate, and then placed his identity card in the designated position.
The next second, a light curtain appeared in front of her. On the light screen was a sentence formed by the gathering of spiritual power——
[You are welcome to borrow books from the Classics Department. Please keep them properly during the borrowing period and return them on time. Penalties will be imposed for damaged, lost, or delayed returns of books. 】
[Please select your borrowing period. 】
Wen Xi:......
Qimingzhou is really advanced.
Which genius invented these formations?
After completing all the procedures, Wen Xi put the book into his space bracelet and planned to go to the cafeteria to get two steamed buns to fill his stomach when he was hungry in the middle of the night.
Unfortunately, when Wen Xi arrived at the canteen, it was already closed.
She touched her belly and returned to the dormitory with some regret——
Well, I must remember to take two steamed buns in advance and store them in the dormitory tomorrow.
When Wen Xi returned to the dormitory, he saw a food box at the door of the room.
She slowly squatted down and opened the food box. The top layer was a stack of fish-flavored shredded pork and several stacks of pickles, and the bottom layer was a bowl of rice porridge made from spiritual rice.
Wen Xi removed his chopsticks and saw a note——
"Xiao Xi, I'm sorry that I did something without permission that might bother you, but you won't be able to get food after the canteen is closed. I saw that you had no plans to leave the Classics Department in a short time, so I took some food and sent it to your dormitory."
"Don't worry, I sealed a layer of spiritual power on it, and others can't open it."
The signature is Xiao Zhu.
From reading the lines, Wen Xi could imagine that when Xiao Yao left this note, he must have been smiling and speaking in a gentle tone.
Wen Xi's hand rested on the edge of the food box, and his fingertips could still feel the heat wafting from the food.
She lowered her eyes slightly, her expression completely hidden in the shadows under the moonlight, and even the red mole between her eyebrows lost some of its color.
Wen Xi twisted the note in his hand, feeling a little at a loss.
Although it is a natural identity and there is no such thing as replacement, Wen Xi always feels that both Xiao Yu and Tianqi's lord and queen care about her because of the plot setting.
And she had never gotten along with strangers, so she was always very awkward...
Wen Xi sighed helplessly.
If you want to become a direct disciple as soon as possible, it is best to be on a peak with fewer people, so that you don't have to get along with strangers.
She is still used to staying with flowers and plants.
——————
Entering the room, Wen Xi packed up his space ring and prepared the disciple uniforms he would wear in class the next day.
She picked up a wet towel and wiped her face. After regaining her energy, she opened the book "Introducing Qi into the Body"Cheng" read it carefully, trying to fully understand every sentence.
After reading it for the first time, Wen Xi sat cross-legged on the meditation table and spread the book in front of him.
